name: Hotaru II
source:
Taiyou Suna is famous as an actor as well as a singer. However, his previous scandals are still known to everyone. The characters take advantage of this to increase the ratings on your TV show. However, after the truth is revealed, the TV men go out of their way to help him.

[From [url=http://www.rainbow-shoppers.com/en/www/list.cgi?id=G000518100019]Rainbow Shoppers[/url]]
translation:
砂根太阳是一名知名演员兼歌手。不过，他以往的丑闻仍人尽皆知。剧中人物利用这一点，来提高你所主持的电视节目的收视率。然而真相揭开后，电视台的人不遗余力地帮助他。

[摘自[url=http://www.rainbow-shoppers.com/en/www/list.cgi?id=G000518100019]Rainbow Shoppers[/url]]
